One issue with 2d Marching Cubes (i.e. Marching Squres) that I glossed over in my original tutorial is the issue of ambiguity. Later I talk about how dual contouring avoids this problem. But it turns out there's actually a well known, but little documented way of resolving those ambiguities called the Asymptotic Decider, which I'll explain below.
